## Checklist

- [ ] Ran the area's builder locally and looked at the chart
- [ ] Series codes checked against the live source page
- [ ] Chart `note` says whether the data is seasonally adjusted
- [ ] Units, start date and any rebase are right
- [ ] No regenerated data for other areas included (`git restore data img`)
- [ ] Any new code is commented in plain English
